newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Thursday, turning slow by mid-afternoon, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 17,700 slaughter steers and 8,500 heifers; 109,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,800 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 64.00-65.00. Pen mostly Select 1-3 1150 lb cutting bulls 63.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1300 lb Holsteins 60.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00 to mostly 66.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00.
Wk to Date -109,200 Week Ago - 135,700 Year Ago - 119,700
